module.name: Concurrency Count
module.changelog: *2.2.1 (17 September 2026)* Hardens alert-mail bootstrapping and retry state, Test email feedback, notification copy and Live Settings controls. Makes Demo scenarios ephemeral with corrected audit paging, live-headroom disk protection and mandatory cleanup after cancellation, runtime or resource termination. Excludes zero-duration ANSWERED CDRs from Historical calculations, keeps active Critical PBX protection throughout calculations, bounds Trunk peak-evidence acquisition while isolating reserved Demo rows, adds CSV formula safety and concurrent Historic Report inventory/order recovery, clarifies exclusion actions, and fixes graph selection/hit-testing and Live Wall windowed, mobile and edge-to-edge behaviour. *2.2.0 (15 September 2026)* Adds modelled Historical progress and ETA, PBX Protection, configurable Maximum runtime and Minimum concurrency, bounded database-aware CDR acquisition, multi-series graph exports, and grouped Exclude All/Restore Group exclusions. Reworks Demo around the pinned CDRgen 1.1.0 core with deterministic scenarios, authoritative PJSIP inventories, audit/provenance reporting, conservative preflight and exact cleanup including legacy MariaDB 5.5.65 support. Live Wall adds Light/Dark themes and improved fullscreen layout. *2.1.1 (28 August 2026)* Fixes Live View Hide/Unhide persistence and stale settings responses. Improves long-running Historical ETA/runtime handling, adds hard-runtime checkpoints, cooperative GUI Stop, single-active GUI calculation locking with abandoned-page cleanup, CLI SIGINT/SIGTERM cancellation where available, and temporary resource telemetry. *2.1.0 (27 August 2026)* Adds Live View and Live Wall, persistent presentation and monitoring controls, authoritative FreePBX PJSIP identity with reversible unknown-endpoint classifications, global reversible Historical call exclusions, shared endpoint filtering across Historical output, stricter CLI/date validation, and Historical graph and worker-health fixes. Live concurrency is explicitly trunk-only. *2.0.1 (27 August 2026)* Historical Trunk Concurrency results show compact peak occurrences inline beneath each trunk with accessible lazy call details. Historical Report tabs are now created only when a validated report is run, support persistent custom names, and provide clearer hover and long-name handling. *2.0.0 (26 August 2026)* Initial release. UI module port of the Concurrency Count CLI tool. Calculates maximum concurrent calls per PJSIP trunk, extension, or group within a date range, with a Live Command Centre (AMI-backed current state, threshold alerts via a supervised PM2 worker), persistent Historic Report tabs (up to five, saved report definitions restored across sessions), an optional 'sweep' calculation engine alongside the original per-second occupancy algorithm, and email/download output.
module.description: Live and historical PJSIP concurrency visibility with configurable Live View and read-only Live Wall dashboards, threshold monitoring and alerting, historical trunk, extension and PBX-wide group reporting, and GUI/CLI management. NOT CURRENTLY SUITABLE FOR PRODUCTION.
